# Godrej Verano Gurgaon (godrejverano.org)

> Information site for Godrej Verano, a residential project by Godrej Properties Limited in Sector 63A, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122102, India. Run by an authorised channel partner of Godrej Properties; this is not the official Godrej Properties website. Contact: +91 9211535553, aaptdubey@godrejverano.org. Last updated 31 October 2026.

## Key facts (as of October 2026)
- Developer: Godrej Properties Limited (NSE/BSE listed)
- Location: Sector 63A, Village Ullawas, off Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram
- Land: 11.36 acres bought outright in March 2026; Phase 1 registered with HRERA on 9.65 acres
- Towers: 4 residential towers, G+39 (Towers 1 and 4) and G+40 (Towers 2 and 3), 4 apartments per floor
- Homes: 624 residential units plus 6 shops
- Clubhouses: 3 (about 2 lakh sq ft total club area), more than 80 percent of the plot open
- Configurations: 3 BHK (2,133 to 2,185 sq ft), 3 BHK + utility (2,560 to 2,726 sq ft), 4 BHK + utility (2,909 sq ft), 5 BHK + utility (3,829 sq ft). Super built up area.
- Price: Rs 22,500 per sq ft of super area. 3 BHK Rs 4.80 Cr to Rs 4.92 Cr, 3 BHK + utility Rs 5.76 Cr to Rs 6.13 Cr, 4 BHK + utility Rs 6.55 Cr, 5 BHK + utility Rs 8.62 Cr. IFMS, CAM and government charges extra.
- Payment plan: construction linked. 5% application money and 10% in total within 18 days of booking, 15% on 1 June 2027, 25% on 4th floor slab or 15 September 2028 (whichever later), 25% on 32nd floor, 20% on application for occupation certificate, 5% on offer of possession. EOI Rs 10 lakh, adjusted in booking.
- HRERA registration: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/1081/813/2026/53 dated 11 August 2026 (Registration No. 53 of 2026)
- Licence: 129 of 2025 dated 23 July 2025
- Possession: RERA completion 2033; phased possession indicated from 2031
- Nearby: Golf Course Extension Road 2 min, SPR 8 min, Sohna Road 10 min, Sector 55-56 Rapid Metro 10 to 15 min, NH-48 10 to 15 min, IGI Airport about 30 min
